Sorry I went quiet on you. You shouldn't have been sitting there dealing with all this while waiting on a reply from me. I'm here now, and you're not doing the next bit on your own.

I'm off all day tomorrow now Sam's taken my shift. Tell me when to get to Priya's and I'll bring Dad's trailer. I'll help with photos and chasing the landlord too, because that portal reply is bullshit and you're not dealing with that grub on your own.

Ruby says our couch is yours for as long as you need, not just till Wed. Only warning: Clover will absolutely try to sleep on you.

You drove out to Gatton at 2am when my car carked it and never once made me feel like a hassle, so don't try that line now. Let us be there for you too.

And Rocky can wait. I don't mean you can never go, but don't decide you've failed and pack up your whole life from Priya's couch while you're exhausted and everything's in garbage bags. Get somewhere safe to sleep, let us help through the next few days, and if you still want to go then we'll talk about it properly. Just not like this.

Tully's lined up the Lantern Room for Sat 28th for a benefit night, all door money to you, and Hollow Pines are keen to play too. You don't have to play or make a speech or anything. Jono's cousin also has an old Yamaha you can have. Not a Nord, but it works.

You're not quitting the band over this. Your songs are the best thing about Soft Servo. When you're ready, not necessarily this week, we'll sit down and put down whatever you can remember. For now, just send me a time for tomorrow.
